units.source_text: 紫夫人一向怕热，今年夏天更觉难堪，常常热得发昏。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had always suffered from the heat, and this summer it was even harder to bear; she often grew faint from it.

units.source_text: 她并不觉得某处特别痛苦，只是身体日渐衰弱下去。

en.t: She did not feel any particular pain anywhere, but her body was weakening day by day.

units.source_text: 因此旁人看了也并不惊慌狼狈。

en.t: For that reason, those around her did not become especially alarmed or distraught when they saw her.

units.source_text: 众侍女推想今后不知究竟怎样，但觉眼前一片黑暗，实在可悲可惜。

en.t: The serving women wondered what would become of things, feeling only darkness before their eyes; it was truly sad and pitiable.

units.source_text: 明石皇后闻知继母只管如此，也乞假归宁。

en.t: When Empress Akashi heard that her stepmother remained in such a state, she too requested leave and returned to visit her family home.

units.source_text: 她的住处定在东所。

en.t: Her lodgings were arranged in the eastern quarters.

units.source_text: 紫夫人这边也准备迎驾。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's household also prepared to receive the imperial visit.

units.source_text: 皇后归宁的仪式与向例无异。

en.t: The ceremony for the Empress's return home was no different from the usual precedent.

units.source_text: 但紫夫人想起自己不能亲见她来日的荣华，看到一切都不胜悲伤。

en.t: But when Lady Murasaki thought that she would not live to see the Empress's future glory with her own eyes, everything she saw filled her with unbearable sorrow.

units.source_text: 她听见皇后的随从一一唱名，倾耳而听，知道这是某人、那是某人。

en.t: She heard the Empress's attendants being announced one by one, listened closely, and recognized who was who.

units.source_text: 许多高官贵人陪送皇后来此。

en.t: Many high officials and nobles escorted the Empress there.

units.source_text: 明石皇后久不与继母相见，见了觉得异常可亲，畅叙别情，娓娓不倦。

en.t: Empress Akashi had not seen her stepmother for a long time, and on meeting her found her extraordinarily dear; she spoke freely of all she had felt in their separation, talking on without tiring.

units.source_text: 此时源氏主君进来了，他说：“我今夜真像离巢之鸟，甚是没趣。

en.t: Just then Lord Genji came in and said, "Tonight I feel just like a bird separated from its nest, terribly out of sorts.

units.source_text: 让我到那边去休息吧。”便回到自己房间里去。

en.t: Let me go over there and rest." With that, he returned to his own room.

units.source_text: 他看见紫夫人起身，心中欢喜。

en.t: When he saw Lady Murasaki sit up, he was glad at heart.

units.source_text: 但这也不过是暂时的快慰而已。

en.t: But this was no more than a momentary comfort.

units.source_text: 紫夫人对明石皇后说：“我们分居两处，要你劳步，太委屈了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki said to Empress Akashi, "Since we are staying in two separate places, it is too much to trouble you to come here.

units.source_text: 而要我到那边去望你，实在走不动。”

en.t: But if I were to go over there to see you, I truly could not walk that far."

units.source_text: 明石皇后就暂时住在紫夫人这里。

en.t: So Empress Akashi stayed for a while with Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 明石夫人也来了，静静地与紫夫人共话衷曲。

en.t: Lady Akashi also came, and quietly shared her innermost thoughts with Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 紫夫人心中想起许多事情，但并不噜苏地谈起身后之事，只是从容谈论一般世间无常之相，词句简洁，含义深长，反比千言万语动人得多，显见其心中怀有无穷感慨。

en.t: Lady Murasaki thought of many things, but she did not speak at tedious length about what would follow after her death; instead she calmly spoke of the impermanence common to the world, in words brief yet deeply meaningful, far more moving than thousands of words, and it was plain that her heart held inexhaustible emotion.

units.source_text: 她看看明石皇后所生皇子皇女，说道：“我很想亲见他们成长立业，因此对于这个无常之身，还有几分留恋呢。”

en.t: She looked at the prince and princess born to Empress Akashi and said, "I long to see them grow up and establish themselves; for that reason, I still have some attachment to this impermanent body."

units.source_text: 说罢流下泪来，那容颜异常优美。

en.t: When she had finished speaking, tears fell from her eyes, and her face was extraordinarily beautiful.

units.source_text: 明石皇后想道：“继母为何如此悲观？”便哭起来。

en.t: Empress Akashi thought, "Why is my stepmother so pessimistic?" and began to cry.

units.source_text: 紫夫人深恐不祥，并不多谈身后之事，只是嘱咐道：“这些侍女服侍了我多年，没有可靠的亲属，怪可怜的。

en.t: Lady Murasaki deeply feared saying anything inauspicious, so she did not speak much of what would come after her death, but only gave this request: "These serving women have attended me for many years, and they have no reliable relatives; they are truly to be pitied.

units.source_text: 像某人、某人等，我死之后，务望多多照拂。”

en.t: As for such-and-such and the others, after I die, I earnestly hope you will look after them well."
